integrity: Standalone oracle verification includes 74,954 exhaustive binary matrices of dimensions 1..4, explicit bisimulation certificates, and direct Boolean closure checks; general result proved by constructive structural argument.
scientific_limitations: Complete rectangular two-equivalence frames, exactly one propositional generator; not arbitrary relational frames. No independent audit. The original full text of Bergman (1982) was unavailable, leaving a specific historical originality risk.
title: Ferrers rigidity and the exact one-generator census of finite two-agent epistemic grids
